name: Legends of the Pitch

short_description: A 5-hour horror game where investigator Igarashi, tasked by the police, enters a haunted campus after a murder case kills four students. With her partner Shimo, she sets out to uncover the truth behind the "ghost killings."

name: Lord Liberty Quest II ~Pure White~
short_description: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

short_description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 3,235 scattered bottles, glasses, casks and more throughout a three-storey bar. Match every item to its proper place, combine half bottles, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

name: Catch The Fish
short_description: Catch The Fish is a chaotic fishing action-adventure where your catch fights back. Cast into lava, battle aggressive fish and powerful bosses, feed monstrous traders, and upgrade your weapons as you sail across seven strange and dangerous islands.

name: Not Suitable For Screening
short_description: Assume the role of Assistant Film Censor Florian Schulz. Your job is to decide which films will be shown to public, balancing your duty to the nation with the need to provide for your family. Every decision carries weight. Shape the future of your country and protect those you love.

name: Astral shifter
short_description: Play as a mysterious mage, clearing falling star clusters on a hex grid with Rubik's Cube-style moves. short_description: A short, cozy mushroom experience in five small maps. Relax by a forest lake, change the weather around a spotted mushroom, hunt for a hidden mushroom, stay for a cosmic beat drop, then explore a misty jungle in third person. Deeply spiritual? Probably not. Mushrooms? Absolutely.

name: Space Tanks
short_description: Like a forgotten Atari classic, only from 2003: Space Tanks introduced a new artillery gameplay concept and made gravity truly intuitive to play for the first time. This is the original 2003 game, not a remake. 30+ weapons, 70 tanks and strategy deliver that “just one more round” feeling.
